commitments.detail: Morgan continues as facilitator of the weekly planning meeting, with the meeting scheduled to end by 15:30 to accommodate Morgan's caregiving constraint for the next 30 working days.

Written feedback on planning contributions will be provided within 24 hours when corrections are needed outside of the meeting, ensuring teammates have timely and clear documentation to support smooth handoffs.
Elena will record the scheduling arrangement, facilitation assignment, and all collaboration safeguards with supporting reasons in the case-review settlement.
